Celtiberian language.question: The _____ was Extinct Celtic language of Iberia.
Celtiberian language.fact: Celtiberian or Northeastern Hispano-Celtic is an extinct Indo-European language of the Celtic branch spoken by the Celtiberians in an area of the Iberian Peninsula between the headwaters of the Douro, Tagus, Júcar, and Turia rivers and the Ebro river. The language is directly attested in nearly 200 inscriptions and 300 smaller records, dated from the 2nd century BC to the 1st century AD, mainly in Celtiberian script, but also in the Latin alphabet.

Celtiberian language.fact: The language is directly attested in nearly 200 inscriptions and 300 smaller records, dated from the 2nd century BC to the 1st century AD, mainly in Celtiberian script, but also in the Latin alphabet. Chaco National Park.subject: Environment & Ecology
Chaco National Park.question: The _____ was National park of Argentina.
Chaco National Park.fact: The Chaco National Park (Spanish: Parque Nacional Chaco) is a national park of Argentina, in the province of Chaco.

Chaco National Park.subject: Environment & Ecology
Chaco National Park.question: It was created in _____ in order to protect a sample of the Eastern Chaco, composed mainly of warm lowlands, with an annual summer rainfall between 750 and 1,300 mm
Chaco National Park.fact: It was created in 1954 in order to protect a sample of the Eastern Chaco, composed mainly of warm lowlands, with an annual summer rainfall between 750 and 1,300 mm.

Chaco National Park.subject: Environment & Ecology
Chaco National Park.question: Forests of quebracho colorado chaqueño (_____ balansae) were once located in the north of Santa Fe and the western half of Chaco, and had entered the northeast region of the province of Corrientes
Chaco National Park.fact: Forests of quebracho colorado chaqueño (Schinopsis balansae) were once in the north of Santa Fe and the western half of Chaco, and had entered the northeast region of the province of Corrientes. The scrubland is the habitat of the red quebracho (Schinopsis lorentzii), white quebracho (Aspidosperma quebracho-blanco), algarrobo (Prosopis alba), and lapacho (Tabebuia spp.), all of which are commercially valuable species.

Chaco National Park.subject: Environment & Ecology
Chaco National Park.question: Elsewhere there are armadillos, _____ tapirs and plains viscachas, as well as birds (more than 340 species)
Chaco National Park.fact: Elsewhere there are armadillos, South American tapirs and plains viscachas, as well as birds (more than 340 species).

Chaco National Park.question: The fauna also includes the black howler monkey (_____ caraya)
Chaco National Park.fact: The fauna also includes the black howler monkey (Alouatta caraya).
